user.title: Aurora Energy (Aurora+) Setup
user.description:
**Step 1:** Click the link below to open the Aurora+ login page.

[Log in to Aurora+]({auth_url})

**Step 2:** Log in to your Aurora+ account. Make sure to tick **Keep me logged in**.

**Step 3 — paste one of the following into the field below:**

**Option A (easiest):** After logging in, open the browser's Network tab (F12 → Network), filter by `LoginToken`, click that request → **Request Payload**, and copy the `token` value (a long string starting with `eyJ`).

**Option B:** After logging in you will briefly be redirected. Copy the **full URL** from your browser's address bar before the page loads — it starts with `https://my.auroraenergy.com.au/login/redirect?code=`.
